info.title: Stress Test API
info.description: A large synthetic OpenAPI document used only for QA/hardening — not a real API. Exercises 50+ operations, many tags, multi-tag operations, deep nesting, oneOf/anyOf/allOf, a circular reference, nullable fields, multiple response codes, a 204/no-body response, a large response schema, varied auth (global/none/OR/AND/unsupported-oauth2/unknown-scheme), and multiple servers.

get.description: This operation's security requirement references a scheme name that is NOT declared under components.securitySchemes. This is a deliberate regression fixture for a known, intentionally-unchanged core edge case: resolveOperationAuth produces an empty AND-group (alternatives: [[]]) when a requirement references only unknown scheme names. This must render without crashing.
